about: Whether a channel shows Slack's lock instead of #. Slack's private channel takes people only by invitation, so a channel is private when its Matrix join rule lets no one in uninvited. A restricted room is open to its space, a public channel there. joinRule is the m.room.join_rules value, any other string a custom rule, and null a rule not known yet.

cases.name: Anyone can join a public room
A room you ask to join is private
The reserved private rule is private
A room open to its space is public there
A room open to its space that also takes requests is public there
A room whose rule isn't known yet shows #
